articles.headline: Police investigating death of South Africa World Cup player Jayden Adams
articles.description: Police said Monday they are investigating the death of South Africa World Cup football player Jayden Adams, after his body was discovered this weekend at a property in the city of Cape Town.

articles.headline: Pau Cubarsí calls for tolerance after Spain's ex-PM questions nationality of France players

articles.headline: Fans in England must live up to 'exemplary' World Cup crowds - police chief
articles.description: Football's chief police officer has praised the behaviour of England fans at the World Cup -- and hopes those watching the matches from the UK start to follow their example.
